about: World 1 acceptance bands: the rows the Gate reads for a finished Spillway (dam, flume, Brindle). scripts/world1-bands.mjs evaluates them. status gate: a miss or a missing input fails the read. status report: measured and printed but never fails, until the units in enforced_from land and the coordinator flips it to gate. status info: shown, no threshold. status sitting: a thing only Andrew can judge at his sitting, listed and never graded. With --sitting the rows are the whole definition of world 1 done (ruling dt): every one of the 11 areas has gate rows and one sitting row, a source receipt row reads the JSON receipt of a check this reader cannot run and names the command that writes it (producer), and a receipt row with a plant passes only when its receipt says that planted fault was caught on the head being judged. Run length lives in the pacing file (source pacing) and the panel band in #398's drop sim; neither is restated here. Thresholds are the integrator ledger's (/mnt/project-files/world1/BUDGETS.md); change a number there first.

bots.measure: the pacing file's measure block (table, stages, seeds, pilots, bot_args, policy_args) is the run recipe; the completionist explores until done with --explore-by=900 as a safety clock (ruling ag)

History: Recorded bands (coordinator ruling ab, DECISIONS section 5, 26 Oct 20:58Z row, PR #504): w1 Novice <= 40% (two seeds of margin over the measured 33% at 24 seeds) at dam mob hits x1.5 (33%, 24 seeds, receipt /mnt/project-files/world1/bands-w19/); park1 and park2 Novice reach stays at the measured 100%: re-read after the pacing lock rows landed (24 seeds a band on d30a2965, library learner-0e2bc2f0, receipt /mnt/project-files/world1/bands-w20/park-reach-d30a2965/), Novice 100% [86%-100%] and Learner a1 100% on both parks. The yard lock and the Warden clamp sit on the way to the Warden or in its fight, and a parkN cell wins when the Warden is engaged, so neither moves reach; a cell that grades the park clear would see them. w1 Learner a5 grades against the >= 60% harness target again (9 Nov, wave 33, DECISIONS section 10): ruling bb's wave 29 waiver (>= 58%) is retired, measured 83% (20/24) on w31 and w32, receipt /mnt/project-files/gate/w32-58a6de62/bands-B.md. w1 Novice <= 42% for w31 (coordinator, ruling ab re-pin, DECISIONS row bk, 8 Nov): measured 42% (10/24) on stage/alpha-w31 1013c7d1 and 0786c1a8, every run identical; #619's reseed plus rulings bf and bg make every band stronger (overpowered pays); re-read after the sitting; provisional until the bands B rerun on the ruling bl head (the bot's point-blank bite cadence), which decides the number. rows.label: the same seed plays the same run whatever order contacts arrive in
rows.producer: node scripts/gate/contact-orders-receipt.mjs --out <dir>/same-seed-same-run.json, on a clean checkout of the head (it takes the head from git): it runs sketches/core-loop/tests/contact_orders_all_test.gd alone through scripts/sketch-smoke.mjs, every arrival order of five sets of up to four same-tick contacts on the real code, each on a fresh game (62 orders, pinned); a set whose orders end in different states fails it, named. Touches take effect together at the first body_entered of a tick (src/movement/rigid_ball.gd:353-362), so no hit, pickup or hazard can land between two of them. Faked: the physics server for one tick, every contact new, the state read before the next tick, and calm on, so a hit skips its knock. Not claimed: a pickup with any damage in the same tick, whose end state depends on which lands first (a design call waiting on Andrew)
rows.plant: the contact sort bypassed (CONTACT_PLANT=nosort, a test-only switch) must make the test fail
rows.basis: plan track V3, check F-C; LESSONS 71 and pull request 1027

rows.plant: the settle ledger removed from the model (rewards-broken-ledger.cfg) must show a reward banked twice, a save between settle and unlock (rewards-broken-midsave.cfg) a reward lost, the old key read from the run file (rewards-broken-legacyrun.cfg) a reward lost, and two games deciding on the profile as loaded (rewards-broken-stale.cfg) or without the save lock (rewards-broken-nolock.cfg) a reward banked twice
